prompt: Some people believe that parents should be responsible for teaching children how to manage money, while others believe that schools should teach children these important financial skills. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
While many individuals think that parents should teach youngsters basic financial skills and how to manage money, others believe that schools should teach children these important skills. In my opinion, it is better for parents to teach children how to manage money because they can use their own experiences to prepare them for financial challenges.

One reason why people believe that parents should teach their youngsters how to manage money is that it can help parents make sure their children are ready for financial challenges in the future. This is mainly because when parents explain this subject to their kids, they can use real experiences, which can be much easier to understand. As a result, their children can develop practical financial skills that they will need in the future. For instance, if parents teach their kids how to manage money and talk about problems they faced in the past, their children can learn how to avoid making the same mistakes and make better financial decisions.

On the other hand, others believe that schools should teach children how to manage money because teachers can give students useful knowledge about this subject. This is mainly because schools can teach children how to save money, control their spending and plan their expenses. As a result, students can develop these skills in a suitable learning environment and become more confident when dealing with money. For example, if schools teach students how to make a simple budget and manage their spending, they can learn how to make better financial decisions when they become adults.

In conclusion, although schools can provide students with useful knowledge about managing money, I believe that parents should teach this subject because they can use their own experiences to help their children develop important financial skills.
